Built **NEON DISTRICT**, a playable 3D city-driving game in `index.html`. It includes a procedural city, traffic, delivery pickups, a minimap, speed and wallet HUD, and touch controls for mobile.

Start a shift and collect five drops to complete a run. Drive with **WASD** or the arrow keys; on mobile, use the on-screen steering, gas, and brake buttons. I checked the game in desktop and mobile browser viewports; the browser console reported no errors.

Assumption: “FiveM mobile” meant a mobile-friendly, open-world city-driving experience—not a connection to FiveM servers.
